title: Require CLI Topic Plugin Project Topology
forbids: CLI topic plugin project, source, command, adapter, and test trees that omit required spine members or contain undeclared direct children
why: A CLI topic plugin has one closed project root, a required source and command spine, optional closed source and test adapter trees, and a required closed test spine with optional closed support.
remediate: Keep only the declared project-root members; require src/index.ts and src/commands; use lower-kebab TypeScript modules and directories under optional src/adapters and test/adapters trees; require test/commands and test/tsconfig.json; and use lower-kebab TypeScript modules and directories under the optional closed test/support tree.
message: CLI topic plugins must match the closed project, source, command, adapter, and test topology.
